June, I couldn't set up the 17:30 weekday "Pod end of day" post. The scheduler rejected my request with a credentials error (`gateway cron.list requires credentials`), so I can't create or check recurring jobs from here. Nothing has been scheduled and nothing has been posted.

Someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's auth config. Once that's done, I can set up the job: weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time, starting today (Wed 14 Oct), posting the day's new #strategic-pod messages here. Until then, I can post a digest by hand whenever you ask.
